T: Sailing the ocean for a good feed.
D: A chief's daughter sails across the ocean to find a demigod and restore the heart of an island.
P: Serve the snacks when the coconut pirates attack the boat.
S: Prawns coated in panko and shredded coconut, fried, with sweet chili lime dip
Coconut prawns: prawns dipped in flour, egg and a mix of panko and shredded coconut, fried at 180C for 2 minutes, with a sweet chilli and lime dip.
Diced tuna in soy and sesame over sushi rice with cucumber
Raw tuna diced, tossed with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli, spooned onto rice in little cups with cucumber and seaweed.
Motunui taro chips with coconut lime dip
the gardens and groves on Motunui

Thin taro slices fried crisp and dusted with chilli salt, with a cool dip of coconut yoghurt, lime zest, coriander and a touch of garlic. Peel 600g taro and slice paper thin on a mandoline, then rinse and pat completely dry. Fry in batches in oil at 175C for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and pale golden, then drain and toss with salt and a pinch of chilli powder. Mix 250g coconut yoghurt with the zest and juice of a lime, chopped coriander, 1 small grated garlic clove and salt for the dip.
M: Snapper poached in coconut milk with lime leaf, ginger and chili
Snapper fillets cooked gently in coconut milk with lime leaf, ginger and chilli, finished with lime and coriander, served with rice.
a feast fit for a demigod

Chicken thighs marinated in pineapple, soy, ginger and brown sugar, grilled and basted until sticky and charred, with coconut rice and grilled pineapple. Mix 200ml pineapple juice, 80ml soy sauce, 60g brown sugar, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp grated ginger and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets in half for 4 hours and simmer the rest until syrupy for basting. Cook 300g jasmine rice with 270ml coconut milk and 250ml water. Grill the chicken for 5 minutes a side, basting often, with 8 pineapple slices. Serve with the rice and sliced spring onion.
W: Set coconut milk pudding cut into squares, topped with toasted coconut
Coconut milk, sugar and cornflour whisked together and cooked over medium heat until very thick, poured into a tray, chilled 3 hours, cut into squares, topped with toasted coconut and fresh mango.
K: Coconut water, pineapple, lime and mint blended slushy, served in coconut halves

Coconut water, fresh pineapple, lime and mint blended over ice into a frosty crush, served in halved coconuts or tall glasses with a pineapple wedge. Blend 500ml chilled coconut water, 400g fresh pineapple chunks, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint leaves, 1 tbsp honey and 2 cups ice until slushy. Pour into halved coconuts or tall glasses and garnish with a pineapple wedge and a mint sprig.

s.note: Prawns coated in panko and shredded coconut, fried, with sweet chili lime dip
s.how: Dip 500g peeled green prawns in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then a mix of 60g panko and 60g shredded coconut. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.

s.note: Diced tuna in soy and sesame over sushi rice with cucumber
s.how: Cook 200g sushi rice and cool. Dice 300g sashimi tuna and toss with 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, spring onion and a little chilli. Spoon rice into small cups, top with tuna and cucumber.

m.note: Snapper poached in coconut milk with lime leaf, ginger and chili
m.how: Simmer 400ml coconut milk with 3 lime leaves, a sliced knob of ginger and a sliced chilli for 5 minutes. Add 600g snapper fillets and poach gently for 8 minutes. Finish with lime juice and coriander. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Set coconut milk pudding cut into squares, topped with toasted coconut
w.how: Whisk 800ml coconut milk, 100g sugar and 60g cornflour together in a pot. Stir over medium heat until very thick, pour into a tray and chill 3 hours. Cut into squares and top with toasted shredded coconut and diced mango.

d.note: Coconut water, pineapple, lime and mint blended slushy, served in coconut halves
d.how: Blend 500ml chilled coconut water, 400g fresh pineapple chunks, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint leaves, 1 tbsp honey and 2 cups ice until slushy. Pour into halved coconuts or tall glasses and garnish with a pineapple wedge and a mint sprig.
